editorial:
Imagine living in a place where every single day is Halloween. That is exactly what you get with Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King. He is the best at scaring people, but he is totally bored with his life. When he accidentally finds a portal to Christmas Town, he falls in love with the bright lights and happy vibes. He decides he can do a better job than Santa, so he kidnaps the big guy to take over the holiday. It is a weird, wonderful, and funny ride that feels like a dark fairy tale for all ages.

You will love the look of this movie because every frame is a piece of art. The music is catchy and keeps the energy high, though the plot is pretty simple. The best part is seeing Sally try to warn Jack that his plan is a disaster.
endingExplained: After Jack tries to deliver scary gifts, the military shoots him down. He realizes he was wrong and saves Santa from the monsters. Santa fixes Christmas and flies away, while Jack finally admits his feelings for Sally. They share a kiss in the snow, and the people of Halloween Town accept that being scary is actually their true calling. Everything goes back to normal, but Jack is much happier now.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky characters and holiday mashups.
